artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: The image shows five figures positioned around a pillar, engaged in a dynamic scene. The detailed human forms are muscular, each holding a long, curved object. The figures are in mid-motion, swinging or preparing to strike. The background has a tiled floor, adding depth to the scene. The lines and shading contribute to the dramatic and intense mood of the image.

artworks.title: Christ in the Tomb
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three armored figures in a room with a large stone coffin. The drawing shows three figures in armor, around a decorated stone coffin. The room has detailed architecture and wall surfaces. The figures are depicted resting or holding spears. The drawing includes ornate script text below the illustration. The artwork is detailed with precise lines and hatching techniques.

artworks.title: The Ascension
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene depicting an ascension. The central figure is portrayed with arms open, surrounded by clouds and floating above ground, while a group of figures below gaze upwards. The drawing uses line work to convey texture and depth, emphasizing the central figure's ethereal nature by surrounding them with swirling clouds. The lower portion includes script in a stylized font. The composition focuses on themes of ascension and reverence, with the figures below displaying gestures of awe and reverence.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting humans, animals, and celestial figures. The left side shows nude figures holding torches and interacting. On the right, a rainbow ends in a group of sheep. Two haloed figures on clouds observe the scene below. Additional figures are shown among clouds in the background. German text is included in the foreground. Fine lines and hatching are used for shading and depth.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical judgment scene. The intricate line work shows human figures and animals, possibly goats, being led to the right. Above them, a figure on a goat-like creature is surrounded by radiant lines. On the top left, two figures appear on clouds. The setting is chaotic, with a sense of movement and urgency. The bottom has text in an old script, reinforcing religious themes.

artworks.title: Woe is Pronounced on Covetousness
artworks.description: This drawing features a celestial or symbolic representation with angels and text. The circular arrangement includes cherubic angels positioned around the circle, each blowing or pronouncing the word "Wee." Cloud-like formations surround the angels, creating an ethereal ambiance. The bottom part of the drawing includes stylized calligraphy text, likely providing context or deeper meaning. The number "1549" is inscribed at the top, indicating the year of creation, and the style suggests a combination of religious symbolism and graphical art from the Renaissance era.

artworks.title: Woe is Pronounced on the Scribes and Pharisees
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular arrangement featuring cherubs and the word "Wee". The image consists of a circle made from thin lines, around which drawn depictions of cherubs or angels are positioned. These figures, complete with wings and surrounded by clouds, are stationed at various points along the perimeter of the circle, creating a sense of movement around the circumference. The word "Wee" is inscribed repeatedly both within the circle and along its edge. Below the circle, script in an old-style font is seen, adding an element of written communication. The date "1549" at the top hints at the historical context of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene where figures are ascending from the earth towards divine figures seated on clouds. The intricate drawing shows two angelic figures in mid-flight, with figures below gesturing towards them. Two seated figures rest on clouds, with a dove in the sky. The background features hills and distant structures. Text at the bottom may provide context or a narrative.

artworks.title: Christ Charges the Apostles of their Mission
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals gathered around a central figure gesturing with his hand. Figures are observing from afar and nautical elements are in the background. The scene features individuals draped in robes. The central figure raises his hand as if delivering a message or instruction to a cluster of listeners. In the background, additional figures can be seen walking towards the coast where several boats are moored along the shoreline. Text at the bottom of the drawing likely provides context to the gathering depicted. The illustration is in a historical or biblical style.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene. An angel with large wings is on the left side, holding a branch with leaves. The angel is reaching towards a woman standing under a columned structure on the right side. The woman is draped in garments and holding onto a lectern. Above the angel in the clouds, a divine figure gestures downward. Rays of light descend from the sky towards both figures. The setting has a classical or religious architecture theme with steps leading up to where the woman stands. German text is at the bottom of the image. The composition is detailed with crosshatching and linework typical of engravings or etchings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic encounter in an ornately detailed setting. The scene depicts an angel with large, feathered wings, gesturing towards a woman who stands beside a richly designed lectern or pulpit-like structure. The setting suggests an indoor space, possibly a significant religious or historical moment, with a visible roof and beams, and elaborate drapery that frames a smaller room or alcove. Above the scene, there is an ethereal or heavenly figure with a scroll, amidst clouds, observing the interaction below. An inscription in German is present below the image.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene inside a stable. There is a mother figure kneeling beside a cradle or basket with a blanket, and an older figure standing nearby holding a staff. Two animals, a cow and a donkey, are behind the cradle. The stable has a simple design with a slanted roof supported by wooden beams. In the background is a pastoral landscape. Below the illustration is a block of text in an older script. The drawing is composed with intricate line work, emphasizing shading and contours to create a harmonious balance between the characters and their setting.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene with four figures around an infant, under a shelter. The figures are detailed with robes and contemplative expressions. In the background, there are minimal landscape elements. Beneath the drawing, there is a panel of text in German script.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.description: The image depicts several people gathered around a central figure holding a baby. The central figure is seated behind an altar or raised surface, wearing a tall, ornate hat and flowing garments. Flanking them are individuals wearing robes and shawls. In the foreground, two figures are observing the scene. The setting appears to be within an architectural structure with two large columns.

artworks.title: Man Carries the Cross after Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of men carrying crosses. The scene depicts several figures, each burdened under the weight of large crosses they carry on their shoulders as they walk along a dusty path. The setting appears to be an ancient city with architectural elements like domed buildings and houses in the background. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, suggesting movement and effort. The foreground features a figure at the front of the group, turning to look back at the others while gripping their own cross. Below the illustration, there is a block of text in German script. The detailed linework captures a sense of struggle and determination among the individuals.

artworks.title: No One Who Puts His Hand on the Plow and Looks Back ia a Follower of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man plowing a field with oxen. The artwork shows a man guiding a plow pulled by two oxen, with onlookers nearby. In the background, there is a landscape with buildings and hills. The drawing includes text in German at the bottom. The style features intricate line work, strong contrast, and detailed texture.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Good Samaritan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring two figures in a detailed landscape. One figure, wearing traditional clothing, tends to another who is reclining by a tree. A horse stands nearby with various equipment. In the background, there are rolling hills and a distant cityscape. The drawing includes text at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Payment of Judas
artworks.description: The image depicts seven figures gathered around a table. One man is standing on the left, facing the table and gesturing with his hands. The other figures are seated or standing around the table. The table is decorated with scattered coins. The background is minimal, with a plain wall featuring a rectangular panel or recess.

artworks.title: The Kiss of Judas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. A group of robed figures is standing in the foreground, some engaging with each other. The scene is near a fence with wooden stakes, and rolling hills can be seen in the background. To the right, a group of armored soldiers with shields and spears are approaching. The artist differentiated between various elements like the folds of the robes and the textures of the armor. Underneath the drawing, there is text suggesting the scene's significance. The attention to detail in the clothing, particularly the drapery and gesture, adds character to the scene.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas, and Peter Denying Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The image is divided into two panels. In the left panel, a figure is standing before a seated ruler with two guards behind him. In the right panel, three figures are shown pointing towards an elaborately decorated facade with the date 1548 inscribed on it. A rooster sits on a shelf above. Near them, a solitary figure is seated with his hand to his face. Text beneath the drawing mentions a denial before the crowing of the rooster.

artworks.title: Christ Ascending the Cross with Sin, Death, and the Devil
artworks.medium: etching and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man climbing a ladder with a cross, carrying multiple figures. The drawing shows a muscular figure ascending a ladder leaning against a large wooden cross, while carrying several small, seemingly lifeless figures slung over his back. The scene is set in a landscape with a river or body of water in the background, curving around a village or settlement. In the distance, rocky hills or mountains rise, creating a shallow horizon line. Below the image, there is German text with the name "Corinth" indicating a connection to religious scripture. The art style is intricate and expressive.

artworks.title: Christ Appears to the Apostles
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered together in an indoor setting. One person stands on the right side facing the group. This person has a beard, short hair, and is wearing robes. They are holding a staff topped with a flag that has a cross. The group consists of about twelve people with various expressions, most of whom are men with beards and short to medium-length hair, wearing robes. The scene includes a tiled floor, a ceiling with wooden beams, walls adorned with decorations, and a doorway on the left. Text in an older form of German is present below the scene.

artworks.title: Jesus Identifies Himself before the Arrest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures, an archway, and a tree. The central figure gestures with one hand while facing a group of individuals to the right. To the left, a group of armored figures appear to be falling or recoiling. The backdrop features an archway and a simple fence or wall, with a tree nearby. The sky above features swirling clouds. Below the image, there is a block of text in German script. The drawing is executed with precision, emphasizing line work typical of engravings or woodcuts from the Renaissance or Baroque periods.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo, and the Jews Deny Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed figures. Some are standing on a staircase, with one figure being pointed at. In the foreground, a group of figures, all in similar flowing robes, are gathered together, with one in front gesturing towards a central figure atop a set of steps. The central figure appears to be holding a staff and is flanked by another figure in robes, both positioned near an architectural structure. The scene is depicted in a line drawing style that emphasizes the drapery and form of the figures. The figures are detailed in expression and posture, capturing a moment of interaction with implied significance, highlighted by the architectural backdrop and the written text below the scene.
